protocol: read-only Loop106 focus annotation preflight; no private-map read, no unblind, no model fitting, no threshold selection, no automatic verdict, no split/cache mutation
identity_policy: Focus manual fields must cite content or external evidence. Filename/path/directory/extension/hash/source_sha256/sample_index/split/row order/review rank/model score terms are not sufficient evidence.

decisions.next_allowed_step: merge focus annotations into full blinded CSV

notes: This preflight keeps the review blinded and does not read the private map.
Blank manual fields are allowed as no-op review state; they do not create actionable verdicts.
Actionable focus annotations must cite content or external evidence before merge/unblind.
Identity fields and model scores alone are blocked before Loop107 merge and Loop87 import.
